def _finish(self, returncode):
    if returncode:
        if returncode == AUTHENTICATION_FAILURE:
            warning(_('Authentication failed. Please check your sudo password or cancel the operation.'))
            return
        self.expander.set_expanded(True)
        warning(_('Something went wrong while trying to create the Stoq database'))
        return
    self.wizard.load_config_and_call_setup()
    set_default_profile_settings()
    ensure_admin_user(self.wizard.config.get_password())
    self.progressbar.set_text(_('Done, click 'Forward' to continue'))
    self.progressbar.set_fraction(1.0)
    self.wizard.enable_next()
